    return p[0]/t + p[1]*(A/(1+p[2]*A))*t**3 + p[3]*np.sin(p[4]*np.sqrt(A))*t**1.5
fams={
 'tpow_Apow': lambda p: p[5]*t**p[6]*A**p[7],
 'tpow_expA': lambda p: p[5]*t**p[6]*np.exp(-p[7]*A),
 'exp_t_A': lambda p: p[5]*np.exp(-p[6]*t)*A**p[7],
}
out=[]
for name,f in fams.items():
    def sse(p):
        m=base(p)+f(p)
        m=np.where(np.isfinite(m),m,1e6)
        return np.sum((m-y)**2)
    bounds=[(-20,20),(-5,5),(-5,5),(-5,5),(-5,5),(-20,20),(-3,3),(-3,3)]

    q=least_squares(lambda p: np.where(np.isfinite(base(p)+f(p)),base(p)+f(p),1e6)-y, de.x)
    out.append((2*q.cost/SS,name,np.round(q.x,4)))
    print(out[-1])
